camel_example: aliyun iot GetDeviceTunnelShareStatus --region cn-hangzhou --ProductKey a1Wmy000000 --DeviceName LEGatewayAuto_B3XM000000
description_en: Retrieves the sharing status of a gateway device tunnel
description_zh: 调用该接口获取网关隧道的分享状态
kebab_example: aliyun iot get-device-tunnel-share-status --product-key a1Wmy000000 --device-name LEGatewayAuto_B3XM000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetDeviceTunnelShareStatus

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID:
Enterprise Enterprise instance: This parameter is required. You can view the ID of your Enterprise Enterprise instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console.
Public instance: This parameter is not required
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID：
企业版实例：必须传入此参数。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看您的企业版实例ID。
公共实例：无需传入此参数
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the gateway belongs. A ProductKey is the unique identifier of a product
parameters.help_zh: 网关所属产品的Key，产品的唯一标识符
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en: The device name of the gateway

GmtOpened.description_en:
The UNIX timestamp when tunnel sharing was enabled.

If the value of IsOpen is false, this parameter is empty
GmtOpened.description_zh:
开启隧道分享的Unix时间戳。

当IsOpen的值为false时，此处为空

IsOpen.description_en:
Indicates whether tunnel sharing is enabled:
true: Tunnel sharing is enabled.
false: Tunnel sharing is not enabled
IsOpen.description_zh:
是否已开启隧道分享：
true：表示已开启。
false：表示未开启

Password.description_en:
The tunnel sharing password.

If the value of IsOpen is false, this parameter is empty
Password.description_zh:
隧道分享密码。

当IsOpen的值为false时，此处为空

ShareId.description_en:
The tunnel sharing ID.

If the value of IsOpen is false, this parameter is empty
ShareId.description_zh:
隧道分享ID。

当IsOpen的值为false时，此处为空

ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息
